obligations.summary: Notifying authorities may only notify conformity assessment bodies that have satisfied the requirements laid down in Article 31.
Notifying authorities shall notify the Commission and other Member States, via the Commission's electronic notification tool, of each conformity assessment body they intend to notify.
Notifications must include full details of the conformity assessment activities, modules, types of AI systems concerned, and the relevant attestation of competence.

Where a notification is not based on an accreditation certificate, the notifying authority must provide the Commission and other Member States with documentary evidence attesting to the competence of the conformity assessment body and arrangements for its regular monitoring.
exceptions: Notification is based on an accreditation certificate as referred to in Article 29(2)

obligations.summary: A conformity assessment body may only begin acting as a notified body if no objections are raised by the Commission or other Member States within two weeks (where an accreditation certificate is included) or two months (where documentary evidence is included) of the notification.
exceptions: Two-week objection window applies where notification includes an accreditation certificate per Article 29(2)
Two-month objection window applies where notification includes documentary evidence per Article 29(3)

obligations.summary: Where objections are raised, the Commission shall without delay enter into consultations with the relevant Member States and the conformity assessment body, decide whether the authorisation is justified, and communicate its decision to the Member State and the conformity assessment body concerned.
exceptions: Applies only where objections are raised under Article 30(4)
